Action verbs

3

Grammar: can / can't

can is the same for everyone. No -s, no to!

+ Positive

I / You can sing.
He / She / It can sing.
We / You / They can sing.

− Negative

I / You can't sing.
He / She / It can't sing.
We / You / They can't sing.

? Questions and short answers

Can you sing? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Can he sing? — Yes, he can. / No, he can't.
Can they sing? — Yes, they can. / No, they can't.
She cans swim.
She can to swim.
She can swim.

Choose the right word

True for you

Choose can or can't. Then read your sentences to your teacher.

Then swap! Think of a person from the table. Your teacher asks you. Answer: Yes, he can. / No, she can't.

7

Which room?

Tap a room. Then tap the words for that room. You can use a word more than once!

8

There is / There are

One thing → there's. Two or more → there are.

+

There's a wardrobe.
There are three schoolbooks.

−

There isn't a TV.
There aren't any clothes in the wardrobe.

? Questions and short answers

Is there a TV in your room? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.

Elena's room: Is there …?
